content.text:
With the containers up and migrations applied, the requeue integration test passes - it was purely the missing local services.

Unrelated: in the unit run, `packages/worker/src/quietHours.test.ts` has one failing case ("does not hold deliveries for a freshly created endpoint"). Nothing here touches the worker, so it looks like a pre-existing flaky test; api and shared are green.
